review_evidence: README states that the project formalizes solid abelian groups and results from Lectures V and VI of Scholze’s Condensed Mathematics notes, building on condensed-set/abelian-group infrastructure.

356 of 436 Lean files contain theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations (3,389 declaration hits in the snapshot), spanning sheafification, condensed/solid groups, Ext, projectivity, homological algebra, and related category theory.
Representative checked source includes sheafification and extremally-disconnected/projectivity lemmas; this is a large mathematical formalization rather than tooling or generated scaffolding.
summary: Reviewed lean-solid; retain the solid-abelian-groups and condensed-mathematics development.
